Approvals

No reports waiting for approval.

    Publish a report for approval

    Upload the finished HTML report. The client opens it inside their portal, signed in, and their answers appear under Approvals. When you are done with it, close it to move it to Past approvals.

    Past approvals

    Closed reports and their recorded answers are kept here. Add completed approvals the client sent back, such as a signed PDF; the client sees them in their own Past approvals.

    No past approvals yet. Close a report, or drag a completed approval here.

        Accessibility Compliance Record

        Team only until published

        ACR draft

        Queued changes apply to the newest draft. Earlier drafts are kept; the client never sees drafts.

          ACR updates

          No updates queued. In Approvals, open Work to do and tick an item once it is live.

            Build ACR update downloads the queued changes as a dated list. Publish to client takes the updated ACR: it goes to the client’s Compliance files, becomes the new draft, and the queued changes are marked as applied.

            Files

            Each file lives in one list, and the client sees both lists in their portal. Add files with the buttons, or drag them onto a list. Move puts a file in the other list; Delete removes it.

              Compliance files

              Accessibility Compliance Record, accessibility statement, VPAT and similar. Up to 25 MB each.
